title: Research: slot_remove_keystore missing proto check
description: slot_add_keystore checks proto in the re-insertion loop to distinguish flash vs fsdir when a path matches. slot_remove_keystore does NOT check proto — it removes the first slot whose keystore_path matches, regardless of backend type. Investigate whether this is a latent bug. Paths are unique per backend type by construction (USB flash paths come from sysfs mount points; fsdir paths are user-configured), so a collision is theoretically impossible today. But the asymmetry is a semantic gap: if a future change allows path sharing or if assumptions break, the wrong slot could be removed silently. Decision needed: add proto check for consistency and defensive correctness, or document the invariant explicitly at the call site.
